Motor vehicle tax — DMVv25

Prepare Slovak calendar-year motor vehicle tax from the native fleet register.

Version19.0.1.0.0
EditionCommunity and Enterprise
LicenceAGPL-3
Requiresl10n_cssk_core, l10n_sk_base, base_iban, fleet

Accounting → Reporting → Statutory Reports → Motor vehicle tax.

Scope

Slovak legal entities with an ordinary calendar-year period, EUR amounts and L1e–L7e, M1 or N1 vehicles. Liability uses reviewed whole months, independently of VAT deduction, fuel expense percentages and mileage records. Other vehicle categories, exemptions, combined transport, special short periods and repeated liability intervals for the same registration are outside this edition. The application blocks these unsupported selections or duplicate rows rather than classifying them as an ordinary vehicle.

Preparing a return

Use Fleet → Vehicles → Slovak vehicle tax to record the certificate facts. The first registration is separate from the company's acquisition/registration date. Power for electric vehicles must be in kW. Document hybrid status before claiming its reduction. This edition calculates ordinary taxpayers a/b; record exemptions/outside-scope grounds explicitly instead of discarding a car.

Add company fleet vehicles imports ready vehicles, including sold or archived vehicles and refreshes the list. The chatter retains every skipped plate and reason: missing facts, unsupported category/taxpayer, exemption, dates outside the year, or no assigned company. Assign shared vehicles explicitly to their owning company before import. Review the imported snapshots. After a fleet edit use Refresh fleet snapshot and review again.

Record Reviewed business use / holding start and its section 8 evidence on every taxable vehicle. Fleet's Registration Date defaults to today and is never used as evidence of tax liability. For a car held for years, enter that actual historical start even if its fleet card was only created today. Review the section 8(5) next-month rule on a taxpayer transfer. The engine converts reviewed event dates to statutory month boundaries. No trip-log module is required. 1. Complete the company's DIČ and registered address. VAT registration is not required. Street/house number use the common localization address helper. 2. Review the ordinary-period scope, complete taxable fleet, technical documents, Slovak registration, taxpayer status, first registration and actual liability dates. Invoice dates are not automatically liability dates. Include electric vehicles even when their tax is zero. 3. Enter actual paid advances, with evidence also for a reviewed zero. A tax payment is not automatically an advance. Review annual adjusted rates for the entire fleet taxable at the following 1 January. The proposal button uses known vehicles and clears the review evidence; additions/disposals and the applicable next-year rate edition still require review. 4. Calculate. Inspect per-vehicle segments and totals. Export uses the common statutory pipeline, QWeb and the unchanged official DMVv25 XSD. Each rate segment is rounded down separately; the monthly fraction is not rounded. The statutory small-payment threshold does not erase the return's tax row. 5. Download the XML. An unfiled calculation/export becomes stale if its facts, company identification, template or edition change. Reset and recalculate.

Corrections and retained filings

Recording a filing requires a reference and actual confirmation evidence. Only one regular filing is allowed per company/year, including concurrent workers. Use a correction linked to that original for subsequent filings. This action records a fact; it does not transmit the return. The exact XML, calculation and source workpaper are retained. A filed return cannot be edited, reset or deleted. Its download does not reinterpret today's company data.

Prepare a separate corrective return before the ordinary deadline; it is a complete replacement. After that deadline use additional, with discovery date and reviewed grounds/filing eligibility, including any audit restrictions. The latest retained filing of the same company/year must be the baseline. Reconcile every previous vehicle once, including unchanged vehicles, and add newly discovered vehicles as needed. Prior-vehicle links make differences explicit even when a registration number or technical datum was corrected.

To completely remove an erroneous former liability, retain its linked row, correct the actual liability dates to outside the return year, explicitly review complete removal and document the grounds. The result preserves the original tax, zero corrected tax and signed difference. Deleting the former vehicle without reconciliation is refused.

Additional returns carry the signed vehicle and aggregate differences and keep the original advances. Later tax payments must not be relabelled as advances. A changed projected-tax row does not automatically change the already applicable advance schedule. A separate company-IBAN repayment request requires a positive overpayment and review; it is not a received refund. Such a request is cleared when preparing a correction, preventing accidental duplicate requests.

Architecture and verification

The domain models are technical filing workpapers. Accounting entries and bank payments remain native account.move / payment / reconciliation operations; this calculation creates none. No public context flag bypasses generated-field guards. Child facts and filings have active-company rules; accounting users and managers have explicit native-style ACL. Draft facts may be edited; generated results, active XML and filed snapshots are protected in both UI and API. Accounting users read fleet sources; a fleet officer maintains them. Statutory editions are system-administrator configuration. Same-content storage migration and download-token generation preserve the exact XML rather than replacing it.

Run Odoo with --test-enable --test-tags=/l10n_sk_vehicle_tax and install/upgrade this module. Tests cover the official 2026 hybrid example (86.95), segment rounding, multi-page/zero-rate XML, corrections, stale facts, direct API/default guards, company isolation and an ordinary accounting manager without sudo. XSD validation is distinct from acceptance by an authority.
